meta.title: Kvarta Roastery — fresh coffee from Minsk
meta.description: Small batches, roasted three times a week, delivered within 1–3 days of roasting. The roast date is printed on every bag.

hero.title: Coffee, roasted this week
hero.lead: We roast in small batches and send your order within 1–3 days of roasting — no shelf coffee here.
hero.note: Leave a request — and we'll get in touch.
hero.imgAlt: A roasting machine with beans in our workshop
schedule: We roast on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays
Orders go out within 1–3 days of roasting
Roast date is printed on every bag

about.title: We roast our own coffee — and freshness is what decides it
about.p1: There are two of us, and we care about quality rather than quantity: we roast only what we can sell within a couple of weeks.
about.p2: Coffee is not wine: its aroma lives through the first three to four weeks after roasting, then the beans slowly lose what made you pick them. That's why we print the roast date on every bag and never hold beans longer than needed.

items.title: Small batches
items.text: We roast two or three times a week — for orders, not for the shelf.

items.title: Within 1–3 days
items.text: Your order goes by courier or waits for pickup within 1–3 days of roasting.

items.title: Date on the bag
items.text: You can see when we roasted it. If something's off — call, we'll replace it, no questions.

about.caption: We pack every bag ourselves on the roast day.
about.imgAlt: Freshly roasted coffee being packed in our workshop

products.title: What we've roasted
products.subtitle: Prices per bag. Roasts come and go with the season — if one is out, we will suggest a similar flavour over the phone.
products.foot: Not sure what to pick? Send a request without choosing — the manager will ask how you brew (espresso, turka, pour-over) and suggest the right roast.

brazil.name: Brazil Cerrado
brazil.alt: Dark-roasted Brazil Cerrado beans for espresso

drip.name: Drip bags
drip.roast: Brew anywhere: open, pour hot water, done

subscription.title: Subscription — coffee just arrives
subscription.text: Once a month we bring two 250 g bags of freshly roasted coffee — no reminders, no shop runs.
items: Two 250 g bags a month, free delivery
You can swap the roasts or skip a month — just tell the manager
Pay on delivery, no online payment
subscription.note1: That's 2 × 250 g bags with delivery. For comparison: two bags separately — {compare} BYN plus delivery.
subscription.note2: The first time we call you ourselves; after that we deliver on a day that suits you.

delivery.title: Delivery and pickup

city.title: City delivery
city.text: Courier delivery within 1–3 days of roasting, at a time we agree on by phone.
city.fee: {fee} BYN for a one-time order. Free delivery with a subscription.

pickup.title: Pickup
pickup.text: Free, and you can pick it up on the roast day — just tell the manager when they call.

delivery.note: Where exactly and when — the manager will confirm on the call. Another district or time? Just say so: we deliver those too.

order.title: Leave a request — we will call back
order.lead: Pick what you're after and leave your number. The manager calls back within a working day, sorts out the details and places the order. Pay on delivery, no online payment.

form.title: Coffee request
form.sub: We call once. No newsletters, no spam.
form.oneTime: One-time order — I'll pick a roast
form.commentPh: For example: delivery area, a convenient time, how you brew
form.agreement: I agree to data processing so the manager can call me back and place the order
form.small: We call back during working hours. Prefer to call us? <phone/>

footer.text: A small coffee roastery in Minsk. We roast in small batches and deliver within 1–3 days of roasting.
